narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon and early evening of July 8. Rainfall totals were as high as 1 to 2 inches.
ev: Segments of Interstate 95 between East Girard Avenue and the Vine Street Expressway in Philadelphia became impassable due to flooding.
Minor flooding occurred along Crum Creek downstream from State Road in Upper Providence Township and Marple Township.
Sections of US Route 202 in West Whiteland Township south of US Route 30 became impassable due to flooding.
Church Road in East Whiteland Township was closed at Sweetwater Way due to flooding.
Paoli Pike in Malvern was closed between South Warren Avenue and Devon Road due to flooding.
Cedar Hollow Road was closed around Jacqueline Drive in Paoli due to flooding.
